{{Quote|Cody, get the tanks down. Come in, Cody!|Commander Jet tells Commander Cody to land his AT-TE tanks|<ref name="Landing">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
The '''Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier''', known more simply as the '''LAAT/c''', was a vehicle carrier variant of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] series of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] developed for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Beginning with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the LAAT/c saw use throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] afterward. Manned by a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the LAAT/c was originally designed to deploy [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] onto battlefields, though it was soon modified to accommodate a number of additional vehicles as the Clone Wars progressed, using powerful magnetic clamps to hold payloads in place. The LAAT/c shared the same rear-wing configuration common to all LAAT gunships, though it lacked the undercarriage that the more common [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] used to carry [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] into battle, and also lacked the heavy armament of its cousins.

==Characteristics==
[[File:LAATc-TCWIV.png|thumb|left|250px|An LAAT/c "''[[Wampa Runner]]''" carrying an AT-TE.]]
A [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] gunship measuring 28.82 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Incredible Vehicles" /> the Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier, or LAAT/c, was a carrier model of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] series of gunships. Like the more common [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]],<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> the LAAT/c featured two long wings located at the rear of the craft, and the body of the gunship was considerably thinner than the LAAT/i. A single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] manned the cockpit in the front of the vehicle, which was considerably wider and taller than the rest of the body, and the front featured two light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] for defense.<ref name="Campaign" /> Two large cylindrical engines topped the LAAT/c's wings where they joined the body, and the gunship's two magnetic clamp arms were attached to the body underneath the wings.<ref name="AOTC" /> The gunship, which could travel at a maximum speed of 620 kilometers per hour, used its magnetic clamps to ferry a wide variety of ground vehicles to and from assault ships and transports in orbit.<ref name="Inside" />

==Role==
The LAAT/c was specifically developed to deploy ground vehicles on the battlefield, ferrying them to and from orbiting transports and assault ships. The gunship was originally designed for use with the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] (AT-TE), but Rothana soon modified the LAAT/c to accommodate a variety of vehicles. The LAAT/c was capable of deploying one AT-TE, four [[All Terrain Experimental Transport]]s, a [[Forward Command Center/Legends|Forward Command Center]], one [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|Republic Troop Transport]], one [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]],<ref name="Campaign" /> a [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]],<ref name="TFU" /> or a [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tank]].<ref name="Zillo" />

==History==
[[File:Atteclone1.jpg|thumb|300px|An LAAT/c gunship delivers a AT-TE walker to the battlefield on Geonosis.]]
The Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier was developed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], which was contracted by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to develop a number of vehicles for the secret [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Incredible Cross">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> LAAT/cs were first deployed in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the battle that sparked the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and also saw the unveiling of the Grand Army. Four hundred LAAT/c gunships were deployed during the battle, ferrying AT-TEs into combat; a number of them were used to ensure that the [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery]] units deployed on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] were defended against attack with AT-TEs.<ref name="Inside" />

During the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], one of the first major campaigns of the Clone Wars, three LAAT/c gunships were deployed during a [[Evacuation of Rhen Var|battle]] on the planet [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. Three gunships participated in a [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|battle]] at the planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] not long afterwards, and several LAAT/c gunships saw use when the Republic [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|retook]] Rhen Var. Dropships were used during the [[Battle of Thule|fighting]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Sivvi]], and they also deployed the Republic's ground vehicles at the [[Battle of Thule|final battle]] of the campaign at [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], where the Republic succeeded in destroying the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="Video">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>

Around seven [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the Battle of Geonosis, two LAAT/c gunships were used by the Republic's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to deliver two AT-TE walkers to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]].<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> One of the gunships had the face of a snarling [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] creature on its nose, leading [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to nickname it "[[Wampa Runner]]."<ref name="Incredible Vehicles" /> Numerous dropships participated in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], ferrying AT-TE walkers to the surface of Geonosis in large numbers amid many LAAT/i gunships and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]]. The gunships came under fire from the native [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] during their descent, but several of the dropships under the command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] managed to land and deploy their AT-TEs safely.<ref name="Landing" /> In the aftermath of the battle and the destruction of the planet's [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]], several LAAT/c gunships were used to move debris from the site of the factory as part of the search for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].<ref name="Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

[[File:LAATcZilloBeast-TZB.png|thumb|left|300px|The Zillo Beast is airlifted.]]
When an [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|enormous]] [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] was subdued after the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], a flight of four LAAT/c gunships were used to airlift the unconscious beast to a transport.<ref name="Zillo" /> Numerous dropships were used to deliver [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] and AT-TEs to the surface of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] during the [[Battle of Kiros]]<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Several LAAT carriers participated in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], deploying AT-TEs onto the battlefield.<ref name="Routine Valor">{{StoryCite|story=Routine Valor|book=Free Comic Book Day 2006 Special}}</ref>

The Clone Wars ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the place of the the Galactic Republic, and the new [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] made use of the LAAT/c in the early years after the end of the conflict. Dropships saw use during the [[Battle of Atoa|fighting]] on the ice planet [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]] in 19 BBY, deploying AT-TE walkers to Atoa's surface.<ref name="Lost">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 1|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 1]]</ref> [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Restored Empire]] faction fielded a number of LAAT/c gunships alongside other Clone Wars-era vehicles and ships in their effort to overthrow the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="Crimson" />

==Behind the scenes==
The LAAT/c first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] in the Battle of Geonosis sequence, and they were first named in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference guide for the movie released on [[April 22]], 2002. LAAT/c gunships have appeared in a number of Clone Wars material since then, such as the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] and the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series. [[The LEGO Group]] released a LAAT/c dropship with an [[All Terrain Open Transport/Legends|All Terrain Open Transport]], but it is uncertain if the gunship can carry AT-OTs in [[canon]].
